captions.detailed: A dual-hopper pedestal candy vendor featuring a red-painted metal body, two tall clear plastic reservoirs, and a central dispensing chute below. The unit is supported by a tall grey cylindrical stand anchored to a circular black base. The two top red lids open via rear hinges for refilling, while two grey selector knobs below the reservoirs rotate continuously on horizontal axes to dispense candy. A small red flap door at the bottom of the central chute rotates upward on a lower hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a dual-hopper pedestal candy vendor with two separate tall transparent reservoirs, red top lids, a shared red base with selector knobs, and a central dispensing cup. The model should include rotatable knobs, hinged refill lids, and a hinged flap door on the pickup cup.
captions.factory: Construct the vendor by first creating a base stand using a cylinder for the vertical pole and a flat cylinder for the circular ground base. Model the main red body using box primitives combined with boolean operations to form the dual-hopper receptacle and central chute. Extrude two hollow boxes with thin walls using a transparent material for the clear reservoirs, and add hinged red lids on top. Create two selector knobs as small cylinders, and attach them using continuous rotational joints. Finally, model the pickup flap door at the bottom and mount it with a revolute hinge joint.
